sources.entry: terraform-skill by Anton Babenko - A best-practices skill that teaches the agent to write safer Terraform and OpenTofu through a diagnose-first workflow, failure-mode routing, LLM-mistake checklists, and a feature-version guard table mapping features to their version floor and common errors — covering testing, modules, remote state, CI/CD, and security scanning across AWS/Azure/GCP. summary.one_liner: An agent skill that teaches AI coding assistants best practices for writing, testing, structuring, and securing Terraform and OpenTofu code across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides a skill (SKILL.md under skills/terraform-skill) that AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Codex, and Kiro load when working on Terraform or OpenTofu code. It covers testing with a decision matrix between native `terraform test` (1.6+) and Terratest, module structure, naming, and versioning, plus remote state backends (S3, Azure, GCS, Terraform Cloud) with locking and encryption. It also includes CI/CD guidance for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, cost estimation, and security scanning with Trivy and Checkov. The README mentions optional integration with terraform-ls and the HashiCorp terraform-mcp-server. Versions are noted in the README: use_lockfile needs Terraform 1.10+ and write_only needs 1.11+.
use_cases: write a Terraform module with native tests
configure S3 remote state with native locking
set up a GitHub Actions workflow for Terraform
review Terraform code against best practices
choose between native tests and Terratest
organize state files for multiple teams
add Trivy or Checkov security scanning to IaC
how_to_run: git clone into ~/.agents/skills/terraform-skill (for Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Kiro, and similar hosts)
notable: Works across AI coding agent hosts that support the Agent Skills format, with per-host install steps
Covers both native Terraform test framework and Terratest with a decision matrix
Version-specific guidance, including use_lockfile (1.10+) and write_only (1.11+)
Optional companion code-intelligence plugin and terraform-ls language server support
AWS, Azure, and GCP examples with cross-cloud mapping
caveats: Requires Terraform 1.0+ or OpenTofu 1.6+; newer features need 1.10+ or 1.11+
Optional language server features need a local terraform or tofu binary and terraform init in the workspace
Some install hosts require care to avoid marketplace name clashes with antonbabenko/terraform-skill
